description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with Amazon CloudFront services, including methods for signing URLs and cookies, and various API operations related to CloudFront distributions and configurations.

classes.name: CloudFrontClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon CloudFront, providing methods to create, delete, retrieve, list, and update CloudFront distributions and related resources, as well as signing URLs and cookies for private content.

methods.name: getSignedUrl
methods.description: Creates a signed CloudFront URL with specified options, including URL, key pair ID, private key, expiration, and policy.

methods.name: getSignedCookie
methods.description: Creates signed cookies for CloudFront resources, requiring key pair ID and private key, with optional URL, expiration, and policy.
